articles.summary: Here's everything you need to know injury-wise for Week 3 of the NFL season.
articles.body: Week 3 is underway, and we're tracking all the injuries heading into the weekend.Jump to a team:AFC East: Bills | Dolphins | Patriots | JetsAFC North: Ravens | Bengals | Browns | SteelersAFC South: Texans | Colts | Jaguars | TitansAFC West: Broncos | Chiefs | Raiders | ChargersNFC East: Cowboys | Giants | Eagles | CommandersNFC North: Bears | Lions | Packers (played Thurs.) | VikingsNFC South: Falcons (played Thurs.) | Panthers | Saints | BuccaneersNFC West: Cardinals | Rams | 49ers | SeahawksLive injury updatesThe Seattle Seahawks will have their No. 1 quarterback on Sunday when they take on the Washington Commanders. Sam Darnold, who suffered a glute injury during the opening game of the season, was back at practice on Thursday as a full participant, and was off the injury report on Friday.In Darnold's absence, Drew Lock threw for 187 yards and a touchdown during Seattle's Week 1 win over the New England Patriots. He followed that up during last week's win over the Arizona Cardinals with 235 passing yards and three touchdowns.Head coach Mike Macdonald had said Darnold is "on a good track right now" to play in Week 3; on Friday, he said that Darnold is "ready to go."Caleb Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out and Tyson Bagent (concussion) is questionable to play Monday night against the Philadelphia Eagles. Williams left Week 2 with the injury and is considered week-to-week. Bagent practiced on Saturday, but remains in concussion protocol as part of the process. Case Keenum will either start or serve as Bagent's backup.Other Week 3 injuries to monitor:The Washington Commanders and Jayden Daniels got good news with the quarterback not requiring surgery on his injured elbow. General manager Adam Peters said Friday that an operation is "not on the table" and that they have not talked about placing Daniels on injured reserve, which would rule him out for at least four weeks.Nico Collins has been ruled out by the Houston Texans as he deals with a Grade 1 hamstring strain. Like Collins, Zay Flowers of the Baltimore Ravens also missed Week 2 and remained out of practice this week. He is listed as questionable for their game in Brazil.Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua sat out Friday's practice and is doubtful for Sunday night. Head coach Sean McVay said this week Nacua was "not making great progress" with the hip/groin issue that kept him out of Week 2. McVay added they expect Nacua to be ready to return next week.After being ruled out for the season with a knee injury, New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart underwent surgery on Friday to repair his meniscus. articles.title: Cam Schlittler's gem, Ben Rice's bat send Yankees soaring past Red Sox, even without Aaron Judge
articles.summary: The Yankees left an ailing Judge off the wild-card roster, hoping they could advance without their MVP. Thanks to a gem from Schlittler and a monster night from Rice, they're halfway to that goal.
articles.body: The New York Yankees left an ailing Aaron Judge off their wild-card roster, hoping that they could advance without him and allow him to heal for the American League Division Series.Thanks to a gem from presumptive Cy Young winner Cam Schlittler and a monster night at the plate from Ben Rice, they're halfway to that goal.Schlittler made the most of a career-high 117 pitches to lead a 9-0 shutout of the Boston Red Sox on Tuesday, giving the Yankees a 1-0 lead in the wild-card series. New York is one win away from eliminating the rival Red Sox in the best-of-three series, with Game 2 scheduled for Wednesday in the Bronx.Schlittler shuts down Sox with career-high pitch countSchlittler led the charge and left the mound with a 2-0 lead in the sixth inning after 107 pitches, his night presumably done. But Aaron Boone wasn't ready to move away from his hard-throwing ace.Schlittler returned for the seventh, with the goal of recording at least one more out. He accomplished that mission, then allowed a one-out single to Wilyer Abreu. Only then was his night over.Reliever Paul Blackburn took Schlittler's place on the mound and ensured that the shutout would remain intact. A double-play ground ball from Ceddanne Rafaela ended the frame with New York's 2-0 lead in place.Schlittler's final line: 6 1/3 innings, 10 strikeouts, 2 hits, 1 walk and 0 runs on 117 pitches.From there, New York's bullpen and the Yankees batters put the game on ice.Yankees bats do their partBen Rice hit a solo home run in the fifth inning, making it 2-0 Yankees. He then put the game out of reach with an eighth-inning grand slam that extended New York's lead to 9-0 and helped the Yankees preserve their bullpen.Rice finished the night 4-for-5 at the plate with 2 home runs, 6 RBI and 2 runs scored.Rookie standout George Lombard Jr., meanwhile, went 3-for-4 with two runs scored in his postseason debut. In total, the Yankees piled up 12 hits and 5 walks as Judge cheered on from the dugout. They did most of their damage against Boston's bullpen after a strong effort from Payton Tolle in his first postseason start. He yielded 5 hits, 1 walk and 1 earned run across 4 2/3 innings.It added up to the exact kind of effort New York was hoping for with Judge relegated to being a spectator. Now they need to do it one more time, with two chances to do so. They'll send three-time All-Star Max Fried (2.80 ERA, 5-5) to the mound in Game 2 on Wednesday. The Red Sox will counter with three-time All-Star Sonny Gray (2.72 ERA, 18-5).Roman Anthony's status unclear due to hand flare-upBoston is unsure about the status of leadoff hitter Roman Anthony, who was subbed out in the sixth inning due to discomfort in his right hand. A ligament injury to the ring finger in the same hand sidelined Anthony for most of the regular season.Manager Chad Tracy told reporters postgame that "his hand flared on him" and that he's unsure if Anthony will need to undergo imaging or will be available Wednesday.

articles.title: Samsung gives its two-year-old Galaxy Tab S Plus an overhaul
articles.summary: The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Tab S12 Ultra are launching together, though the larger Ultra is getting a smaller update.
articles.body: Since the Galaxy Tab S10 line, Samsung has updated its flagship Ultra tablet annually, but alternates its regular and Plus variants. It means that this year’s Galaxy Tab S12 series includes an Ultra model with few changes from last year’s Tab S11 Ultra, and a Plus variant that brings a bigger overhaul to the two-year-old Tab S10 Plus. There’s no regular Tab S12, suggesting fans of the smaller size will have to wait until 2027 for the next version of that tablet. The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus should be a meaningful update to owners of the Tab S10 Plus or older. Compared to that tablet, it has a slightly larger and brighter 12.6-inch display, despite running thinner and lighter overall. The MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset is two generations ahead of the old 9300 Plus, and the 10,600mAh battery is bigger too. It’s all enough to make the $200 cost increase, to a new starting price of $1,199, feel worthwhile. By contrast, the Tab S12 Ultra is altogether more familiar, though only because it benefited from those design upgrades last year. Compared to the Tab S11 Ultra, the only real changes are the annual chipset bump and upgraded four-channel spatial audio (also found on the Plus). The Ultra’s 14.6-inch display, 11,600mAh battery, and 5.1mm-thick design are all unchanged year-on-year. That would be easier to swallow if it didn’t also come at a $200 premium, now $1,399. [Image: [Image: [Image: Both tablets benefit from bright OLED displays with 1,600 nits of peak brightness, IP68 ratings, and seven years of Android updates. An S Pen stylus comes in the box, as does a welcome software update: the Android debut of Adobe Photoshop for Tablets, which will be a Galaxy Store exclusive for six months. It comes with Adobe’s AI features, a tablet-optimized interface, and support for the S Pen. [Image: The Android tablet version of Photoshop will be exclusive to Samsung for six months. The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Tab S12 Ultra will hit shelves on October 7th.

articles.title: Amazon’s new Fire TV Stick 4K can pull power directly from your TV
articles.summary: Amazon launched a new Fire TV Stick 4K with support for direct power from TVs and a slimmer design, along with a redesigned Fire TV remote.
articles.body: The new Fire TV Stick 4K will be a little easier to set up than Amazon’s previous 4K streaming sticks since it no longer requires a power adapter. You can power the device directly from your TV’s USB port, like the updated entry-level Fire TV Stick Amazon launched earlier this year. The Fire TV Stick 4K, available starting today for $59.99, runs on Amazon’s refreshed TV OS and includes Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and Bluetooth Low Energy. Amazon’s also simplifying its streaming stick lineup, which now includes four devices instead of five: the Fire TV Stick HD, Fire TV Stick 4K, Fire TV Stick 4K Max, and Fire TV Cube. The new Fire TV Stick 4K is replacing Amazon’s earlier “Select” and “Plus” 4K streaming sticks. [Image: Amazon’s Fire TV streaming device lineup no longer includes the 4K “Select” and “Plus” sticks. A redesigned Fire TV Remote is launching alongside the new streaming stick, featuring a new asymmetrical shape and “more tactile controls.” The new remote is compatible with all Amazon Ember TVs and Fire TV streaming devices from 2019 onward. It will be available standalone for $14.99 and starts shipping late October. Amazon says it also plans to launch a “Plus” version of the new remote early next year, with an aluminum design, backlit buttons, and a “Find My Remote” feature. Fire TV is getting a few software updates, as well, including an Alexa Plus Hub and an Alexa Plus integration in the Fire TV mobile app. Amazon says its AI “now draws on real-world context” like awards and events, helping it answer more complex prompts for show and movie suggestions. articles.title: State GST joint commissioner suspended in ₹2.89cr DA case
articles.summary: Kerala State GST joint commissioner Prajani Rajan suspended after VACB raid in ₹2.89 crore disproportionate assets case; cash, dollars and documents seized.
articles.body: Thiruvananthapuram: State GST joint commissioner Prajani Rajan was suspended late Wednesday following a vigilance case alleging that she accumulated assets worth Rs 2.89 crore disproportionate to her known sources of income between Jan 1, 2014, and Dec 1, 2024. Following a vigilance raid, chief minister V D Satheesan directed her immediate suspension. Rajan is posted as joint commissioner (taxpayer service) at the state GST office in Thevara, Ernakulam.Secretary (taxes) N Prasanth issued the suspension order based on the vigilance director’s report dated Sept 29. Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau (VACB) conducted a preliminary enquiry before registering the case against her under the Prevention of Corruption Act. It seized Rs 14.10 lakh in unaccounted cash and $788 from her Pachalam residence during the investigation, according to vigilance sources.The agency also recovered documents relating to property, title deeds and financial transactions, which will be produced before Muvattupuzha vigilance court. articles.title: Deshaun Watson rallies Browns to a field goal in final seconds to beat the Steelers
articles.summary: The Steelers rallied after a bad first half against the Browns.
articles.body: A little more than a month ago, Cleveland Browns fans booed Deshaun Watson, and Watson shot back at the fans. It was the low point of a toxic relationship. On Thursday night, Browns fans weren't booing. Watson came through when it mattered as he did in each of the Browns' previous two games. After Aaron Rodgers and the Pittsburgh Steelers scored a touchdown and 2-point conversion to tie Thursday night's game in the final two minutes, Watson had a shot to make up for what to that point had been a rough second half. Watson completed enough passes to get kicker Andre Szmyt close enough to try a 56-yard field goal, and he hit it with 10 seconds left to give the Browns a 27-24 win. Cleveland is 3-1 and in sole possession of first place in the AFC North, at least for a few days. "It was electric. It was amazing. This is what it's all about," Watson told Amazon Prime Video after the game. "Nights like this, in Cleveland, in front of our home fans, getting them Ws, getting them wins, this is what it's all about."In the Browns' second preseason game Watson struggled, was booed, then said it was disrespectful of Browns fans to do so. That seemed like it could be the end of a tumultuous relationship. But the Browns stuck with Watson, even though there were plenty of reasons to move on. Now the Browns are 3-1, with three straight wins, and nobody is talking about benching Watson. Browns dominate first halfThe Steelers scored first, and then the Browns took over the rest of the half. Cleveland was moving the ball at will on Pittsburgh. Watson had what might have been the best half he has had with the Browns. He completed 14 of 17 passes for 181 yards and a touchdown in the first half. His 2-yard touchdown pass to tight end Harold Fannin Jr. gave the Browns a 21-7 lead. Watson was in control. He was spreading it around but mostly finding a talented pair of rookie receivers. Second-round draft pick Denzel Boston had 74 yards on three catches in the first half and first-round pick KC Concepcion had 58 yards on four catches.Since the Browns' oft-maligned trade for Watson in 2022, the offense has rarely looked good. Cleveland has suffered through so many bad quarterbacks through the years, the first half had to be unrecognizable to Browns fans. Of course, the struggles of the Steelers' defense played its part in that. At one point Amazon Prime Video showed T.J. Watt making the unusual move of grabbing a headset from an assistant on the sideline and then was in a heated discussion with the coaches up in the press box. Getting picked apart by Watson was driving Watt and the Steelers mad. Pittsburgh's defense was much better in the second half. Browns stall, Steelers get back in itWatt tried to get the Steelers back in the game in the third quarter. He had a great play to strip Watson on a run-pass option and recovered the fumble himself. But his offense couldn't move the ball and punted after a sack. A great challenge by the Steelers' coaches in the fourth quarter got Pittsburgh back in the game. The Steelers got an interception downfield but there was clear defensive pass interference. Pittsburgh challenged, saying linebacker Jack Sawyer tipped Watson's pass. When a pass is tipped, there can be no pass interference afterward. The replay review showed the ball was tipped, so not only was the pass interference penalty wiped out but the interception stood. The Steelers drove down after that pick and scored their first touchdown since the first drive of the game, on a nice Rodgers pass to tight end Darnell Washington. The Steelers didn't get the 2-point conversion but trailed just 21-16.The Browns finally got their first points of the second half on a field goal, pushing the lead to eight points. The Steelers punted quickly but downed a punt at the 1-yard line. Watson had Fannin wide open for what would have been a key first down but he missed him badly and Cleveland punted. Rodgers had 3:32 to get the Steelers a touchdown and 2-point conversion. Rodgers immediately completed a couple of passes to get into Browns territory, and then another pass to DK Metcalf got Pittsburgh to the 12-yard line. Rodgers kept throwing jump balls to Washington and finally on fourth down they drew a penalty to keep the drive alive. The next play, tight end Pat Freiermuth caught a touchdown. The Steelers went for 2 and the tie, and after an offsides penalty Rodgers got in on a sneak to even up the game. Watson moved the Browns into field-goal range, but took a sack that pushed Cleveland back a bit. Then he had a terrible third-down pass, and that left Szmyt to attempt a 56-yard field goal with 15 seconds left. Szmyt hit it. Rodgers' ensuing desperate pass downfield was picked off and the Browns had the win. "Just belief, hope, determination," Watson said, when asked on Amazon Prime Video what he sees in his teammates. "Those guys look at me and they want me to lead the ship. I just told them, 'Believe in me, do what I ask and I'm going to make a play when the opportunity comes.'"The Browns are on a roll. Nobody expected Watson to be leading a first-place team after four weeks of the season.

articles.title: Microsoft AI launches MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming alongside multilingual MAI-Voice 2.1 models
articles.summary: Microsoft has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming model, with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, calling it the most accurate real-time audio
articles.body: Microsoft has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming model, with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, calling it the most accurate real-time audio transcription model in the world. Unveiled alongside two companion speech generation models – MAI-Voice-2.1 and the high-speed MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash – the release is designed to provide developers with responsive, low-cost building blocks for building autonomous conversational voice agents.According to Suleyman, the new voice architecture delivers inference speeds that are 55% faster and operational costs that are 60% cheaper than comparable offerings like ElevenLabs. He said in a post on X (formerly Twitter): “We're launching the most accurate real time transcription model in the world... #1 !!! 55% faster and 60% cheaper than ElevenLabs. Come build agents on our platform!”Real-time speech recognition: MAI-Transcribe-2-StreamingThe headline addition to the company’s audio lineup, MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, provides continuous, low-latency live speech-to-text across 60 languages with built-in automatic language detection. Key performance benchmarks and features include top benchmark ranking as the model has secured the No. 1 spot for accuracy across both partial and completed transcripts on the independent benchmark platform Artificial Analysis.It sits on the Pareto frontier for accuracy versus latency, eliminating the historical tradeoff where high precision required sluggish processing times. Instead of pausing until a sentence ends, the model outputs initial text hypotheses within roughly 100 milliseconds of receiving incoming audio. It refines words as additional context arrives and finalizes stable text immediately.By surfacing partial transcripts as words are spoken, voice bots can trigger API tools and start logical reasoning before the user finishes speaking. For live captioning and automated dictation workflows, internal tests show text appears on-screen twice as fast as the nearest market competitor.Natural Multilingual Output: MAI-Voice-2.1To pair with speech recognition, the team introduced MAI-Voice-2.1, its flagship multilingual text-to-speech engine covering 23 languages and 26 regional locales.The system's standout capability is cross-lingual identity preservation. A single synthetic voice persona can switch seamlessly between diverse languages, such as English, Mandarin and German, without carrying a foreign accent over from one language to another. Instead, the synthesized speaker modifies actual local pronunciation and retains a unique vocal identity.That means brands can deploy uniform virtual ambassadors worldwide, educational sites can switch languages while keeping the same instructors, and customer support agents can respond in the caller’s language without missing a beat.MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash Low-Latency ScaleMAI-Voice-2.1-Flash was introduced by the company for mission-critical, high-capacity applications that demand immediate response times.The Flash version offers the same 23-language voice consistency as the base model, but it is optimized for high-throughput enterprise workloads, and can produce 45 seconds of synthesized audio with an end-to-end latency of just 150 milliseconds.You use AI every day. When a pass is tipped, there can be no pass interference afterward. The replay review showed the ball was tipped, so not only was the pass interference penalty wiped out but the interception stood. The Steelers drove down after that pick and scored their first touchdown since the first drive of the game, on a nice Rodgers pass to tight end Darnell Washington. The Steelers didn't get the 2-point conversion but trailed just 21-16.The Browns finally got their first points of the second half on a field goal, pushing the lead to eight points. The Steelers punted quickly but downed a punt at the 1-yard line. Watson had Fannin wide open for what would have been a key first down but he missed him badly and Cleveland punted. Rodgers had 3:32 to get the Steelers a touchdown and 2-point conversion. Rodgers immediately completed a couple of passes to get into Browns territory, and then another pass to DK Metcalf got Pittsburgh to the 12-yard line. Rodgers kept throwing jump balls to Washington and finally on fourth down they drew a penalty to keep the drive alive. The next play, tight end Pat Freiermuth caught a touchdown. The Steelers went for 2 and the tie, and after an offsides penalty Rodgers got in on a sneak to even up the game. Watson moved the Browns into field-goal range, but took a sack that pushed Cleveland back a bit. Then he had a terrible third-down pass, and that left Szmyt to attempt a 56-yard field goal with 15 seconds left. Szmyt hit it. Rodgers' ensuing desperate pass downfield was picked off and the Browns had the win. "Just belief, hope, determination," Watson said, when asked on Amazon Prime Video what he sees in his teammates. "Those guys look at me and they want me to lead the ship. I just told them, 'Believe in me, do what I ask and I'm going to make a play when the opportunity comes.'"The Browns are on a roll. Nobody expected Watson to be leading a first-place team after four weeks of the season.

articles.title: Beehiiv creators are buzzing about a new price increase
articles.summary: Beehiiv is raising prices across its plans, and many creators aren’t happy about it.
articles.body: Beehiiv, a creator platform that has risen in popularity as an alternative to Substack, is increasing its prices — and many users aren’t happy. In a post explaining the increase, Beehiiv cofounder and CEO Tyler Denk says it will allow the company to “continue investing in our core platform experience.” As part of the change, Beehiiv is changing the name of its midrange Scale plan to Lite, which has gone up by at least $10 per month depending on subscriber count. For someone with up to 10,000 subscribers, for example, Beehiiv will charge $139 / month instead of $109. Meanwhile, the Pro plan (formerly Max) will cost $239 / month for up to 10,000 subscribers, a jump from the previous $219 /month price. Creators with less than 2,500 subscribers can continue using Beehiiv for free. The price hike has several creators on social media reconsidering their decision to use the platform, which many have joined to avoid the 10 percent cut Substack takes from total subscription revenue. In a post on Bluesky, freelance journalist Tim Stevens expresses frustration with the changes to Beehiiv that he’s seen after switching to the platform earlier this year. “Since then, the sponsor choices and ad rates have tanked.” Stevens writes. “Now, Beehiiv is hiking its fees 25%, making this an even less profitable endeavor.” Matt Lombardo, who also recently moved his NFL news site Between the Hashmarks from Substack to Beehiiv, mentioned his issues with the change as well. “Beehiiv raising prices without yet offering video podcasts, a viable consistent growth engine on platform, or podcast ads is pretty frustrating to experience, as someone who enjoys the platform,” Lombardo writes on Threads. In a post on Reddit, Extra Points creator Matt Brown notes that while he believes Beehiiv is a “steal” compared to Substack, he acknowledges that this “really isn’t true for many other publishers,” especially for those who don’t charge a subscription fee for their work: > As these prices increase, I think it’s becoming increasingly clear that if you have under 10K subscribers and rely on Beehiiv to do the majority of your rev-gen, and ESPECIALLY if you’re outside the United States, the answer is going to be No. It isn’t worth it. You’ll be able to get similar functionality at a lower startup cost, and can plug in affilate ads via other networks. Beehiiv has differentiated itself from other platforms by offering a trove of built-in features, including an integrated ad network, website personalization options, and podcast creation tools. The company recently launched a new feature that allows creators to build a community into their website. “It’s only the second time we’ve ever updated our plans and pricing in beehiiv’s near five year history,” Denk writes. “Over the past several years, we have greatly expanded the capabilities of the platform.”

articles.title: Sling TV drops its one-day cable passes
articles.summary: Dish-owned Sling TV will no longer be offering its Sling Pass feature that allowed people to buy a single day of cable TV programming at a time.
articles.body: Dish-owned Sling TV will no longer be offering its Sling Pass feature that allowed people to buy a single day of cable TV programming at a time, as reported by The Desk. The feature was announced last year and offered a day pass, a weekend pass, and a week-long pass option to be able to watch channels like ESPN and CNN without a full-month cable subscription. But soon after it launched, Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery sued Sling TV over Sling Pass, though a federal judge ruled against Disney in its request for a preliminary injunction to block the feature. “Sling was built to give our customers the ultimate control over their entertainment, and Sling Passes delivered on that promise for millions,” Sling TV says in a statement on its website. “Though Sling Passes are no longer available, we look forward to continuing to innovate and showing our customers new ways to experience the content they love.” The Desk also reports that the note was sent to customers.

articles.title: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
articles.summary: As the streamer’s exclusive partnerships with big name directors end, it’s putting more focus on cheap, episodic series.
articles.body: Many of Netflix’s biggest critically acclaimed hits have been the products of its multiyear production deals with noted directors like David Fincher and Shawn Levy. In the past few weeks, though, the streamer has brought some of those partnerships to an end in a way that feels indicative of a larger strategic shift. With rival studios Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery on the verge of a megamerger that will reshape the entertainment landscape, Netflix is clearly thinking about how it can continue to hold its own in the ongoing streaming wars. But as the company charts its path forward, its plan to court subscribers might not put so much emphasis on big-name moviemakers. On Thursday, Netflix shared that its production deal with David Fincher is coming to an end after six years. First announced in 2020, the partnership — which was originally scheduled to last for four years — gave Netflix the exclusive streaming rights to Fincher’s then-upcoming projects like his Herman J. Mankiewicz biographical drama, Mank. With Fincher having previously executive produced original series for Netflix like House of Cards and Mindhunter, the deal seemed to be a sign of Netflix having faith in his ability to keep audiences riveted. At the time, Fincher joked that Mank’s critical reception and box office performance before it began streaming would determine what kinds of projects Netflix would let him make. Critics generally praised the film and it was ultimately nominated for 10 Academy Awards — two of which it won. But during Mank’s three-week theatrical run, it only made around $100,000 against a $25 million budget, and once it hit Netflix, it only managed to spend a single day on the streamer’s list of its top 10 most-watched movies (in last place). Though Fincher’s next project for Netflix — 2023’s The Killer — debuted at No. 1 on the chart, the project’s $452,000 box office gross against a $175 million budget made it another financial dud. And with The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth set to show in theaters for two weeks before it hits Netflix on December 23rd, the film could be another example of Fincher delivering a movie that isn’t exactly a huge monetary win for the streamer. Fincher’s track record with Netflix is somewhat similar to director Shawn Levy’s. After almost a decade of working exclusively with the streamer on projects including Stranger Things, The Adam Project, and Shadow and Bone, Levy announced last month that he had signed a new overall production deal with Disney. Levy — whose directing career began with a number of Disney Channel series — framed his decision to leave Netflix as a kind of homecoming. But it was hard not to see his jumping ship as having been prompted by the way Stranger Things’ final season left audiences and critics disappointed. The same was true when Stranger Things co-creators Matt and Ross Duffer announced last August 2025 that they were leaving Netflix for a four-year TV / film production deal with Paramount. The brothers could still have a hand in future Stranger Things projects, and their next series — The Boroughs — debuted on Netflix this past May to respectable numbers. But just one month after its release, The Boroughs was canceled. In a recent interview with The Hollywood Reporter, Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos said that Levy’s and the Duffer Brothers’ departures were driven by the filmmakers’ desire to spend more time working on feature-length projects. Levy’s Star Wars: Starfighter is slated to premiere next May, and the Duffers’ untitled Paramount film will debut sometime in 2028. Though Sarandos framed the filmmakers’ exits in a positive light, they’re part of a larger trend that makes it seem like Netflix is moving on from its era of signing filmmakers to lengthy deals. The company has also parted ways with Marriage Story writer-director Noah Baumbach, whose other Netflix projects, like White Noise and Jay Kelly, failed to make much of a splash. Netflix is still banking on some directors being a major draw. The streamer’s production deal with Guillermo del Toro is ongoing, and it is treating the first of Greta Gerwig’s upcoming Narnia films as a proper event that will spend seven weeks in theaters before it begins streaming. And while Rian Johnson is taking a break after fulfilling the obligations of his $450 million deal to produce two Knives Out sequels, he could very well come back to Netflix with a plan to make more. Going forward, it seems like Netflix’s main game plan is to put an increased focus on producing lower-budget series, live events, and sports programming. The company obviously isn’t giving up on movies — Gerwig will direct another Narnia feature and there’s a KPop Demon Hunters sequel on the way — but episodic content has been shown to be much more effective at keeping subscribers coming back. This is why we’ve recently seen Netflix hyping up strange reality shows like Squid Game: The Challenge, Wonka’s The Golden Ticket, and The New Stanford Prison Experiment. None of those shows exactly come across as must-see TV like the horror series Mike Flanagan produced for Netflix before Amazon poached him in 2022. But that may not matter to Netflix as long as people are watching. After years of spending millions of dollars to produce movies that did not always result in consistent subscriber growth, Netflix appears to be entering a period of making more conservative bets. That might make the service feel a little less premium than it has in the past, but it could help it live to fight another day.

articles.title: ‘Evil Dead Burn’ OTT release: Where to watch the new horror movie online
articles.summary: The latest ‘Evil Dead’ nightmare has officially made its way to living rooms.
articles.body: The latest ‘Evil Dead’ nightmare has officially made its way to living rooms. ‘Evil Dead Burn’ started streaming on Friday, October 2, 2026, just a few months after its theatrical release.Directed by Sébastien Vanicek, the film stars Souheila Yacoub, Tandi Wright, Hunter Doohan, Luciane Buchanan, Erroll Shand and Maude Davey. Vanicek co-wrote the screenplay with Florent Bernard.For horror fans who missed it in theaters, or those who simply want another round of Deadites; here’s where you can watch the new film.Where can you watch ‘Evil Dead Burn’ online?‘Evil Dead Burn’ is now streaming exclusively on HBO Max. The film arrived on the platform globally on Friday, October 2, 2026. The movie originally hit theaters on July 10 before later becoming available to rent and buy digitally. Now, viewers can watch it from home as part of their HBO Max subscription.And if you’d rather watch it on the big screen of your television with the lights off, there’s another option too.When will ‘Evil Dead Burn’ air?The film to make its HBO premiere on Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET. HBO also lined up a mini ‘Evil Dead’ marathon for the occasion. The 2013 ‘Evil Dead’ was scheduled to air at 4:45 p.m. ET, followed by ‘Evil Dead Rise’ at 6:20 p.m. ET.So, for anyone looking to spend the evening with a few familiar Deadites, there was a pretty fitting double feature leading into the new movie.What is ‘Evil Dead Burn’ about?The story begins with a woman dealing with the death of her husband. Looking for some support, she heads to his family’s secluded home. Things, unsurprisingly, do not go according to plan.What starts as a family gathering soon turns into a nightmare when members of the family become Deadites. The situation quickly spirals into the kind of bloody chaos ‘Evil Dead’ fans have come to expect from the franchise.The film’s official description calls it a “family reunion from hell”, which pretty much sets the tone for what follows.Who stars in ‘Evil Dead Burn’?Souheila Yacoub leads the cast, with Tandi Wright, Hunter Doohan, Luciane Buchanan, Erroll Shand and Maude Davey also appearing in the film.Vanicek directs the movie and co-wrote it with Florent Bernard. Before taking on the ‘Evil Dead’ franchise, Vanicek directed the French horror film ‘Infested’.Sam Raimi, who created the franchise with 1981’s ‘The Evil Dead’, is also involved as a producer. With its theatrical run now behind it, ‘Evil Dead Burn’ has officially found its way home. And for anyone who likes their family reunions with a little more blood, a few Deadites and a lot of screaming, the latest chapter is now just a few clicks away.

articles.title: WWE SmackDown results, grades (Oct. 2): Kevin Owens qualifies for MITB, Randy Orton costs Cody Rhodes
articles.summary: "WWE SmackDown" heads to Denver for the final Money In the Bank qualifier matches. Follow tonight's live results and play-by-play of the action here.
articles.body: "WWE SmackDown" was in Denver on Friday for Cody Rhodes' much-anticipated return and the final Money in the Bank qualifying matches. Unfortunately for the former world champion, he came up short in his match thanks to his bitter rival, Randy Orton.The table is setOh, how I've missed some quality triple-threat action on my TV screen. There's been plenty of negative discourse around WWE's multi-person matches as of late — mostly that they're often used as booking copouts for specific stars to lose without eating pins. Friday was another example of that … but damn, the matches were good.In the end, Kevin Owens and Tiffany Stratton round out the upcoming six-wrestler fields for the men's and women's Money in the Bank ladder matches..@FightOwensFight is headed to New Orleans!! 🔥👏 pic.twitter.com/BX0lJLoDtd— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 Gargano was the expected fall guy in the main event, wrestling alongside powerhouse names like Rhodes and Owens. However, in every recent opportunity, he's reminded us he belongs in this mix.The match was thought to be Rhodes' to lose — but Randy Orton still exists. And if Orton isn't qualifying for this year's ladder match, neither is Rhodes.He made sure of that by stopping two Rhodes pin attempts/break-ups. The last saw Owens hit the Pop-Up Powerbomb on Gargano to secure his spot..@RandyOrton couldn't let that happen! 😤@CodyRhodes pic.twitter.com/aBn1Og7lND— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 Ultimately the story was Rhodes, for a change, valuing personal action over winning. Instead of going back in the ring when he had the chance, Rhodes saw an opening to punt Orton outside the apron, only for an airborne Gargano to intercept him. That spot was kind of funny, but it was an objectively nice wrinkle, and continues to point Rhodes and Orton toward their inevitable stipulation blow-off match.LOOK OUT, CODY!!! 😱@JohnnyGargano @CodyRhodes pic.twitter.com/Yv5tBzqZoP— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 As for Owens, he joins a stacked field of CM Punk, Bron Breakker, Penta, Je'Von Evans and Trick Williams.As Trick would say, "Let's talk about it."All together now!OK, we have to be honest about something: WWE lazily putting on overbooked multi-person promos annually ahead of Money in the Bank has gotten hilarious.But as devoid of creativity as they usually are when everyone just boasts about their future plans to cash in, tonight's one was good solely thanks to Sami Zayn."Unlike you, what if it doesn't take me 20 years to finally get the WWE Championship?"If @SamiZayn wasn't crashing out before, he's about to... 😅@WWEJeVonEvans pic.twitter.com/nIELJ4tjp7— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 Zayn continues to take his victory laps, but he does it by playing into claims that he's a weak champion and mentioning his experience. He really shouldn't be viewed like a chump compared to Penta, Trick Williams and Je'Von Evans, who all confronted him too.The history baked into this segment with Trick was great as well, especially their head-to-head moment that absolutely felt like improv..@SamiZayn has a HUGE target on his back! 🎯 pic.twitter.com/iaC1UZLzih— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 Finn Balor and Gunther got involved to end it on the ramp. That was kind of odd, and left those two feeling more aimless than ever, having just lost their qualifiers last week. But the clear move here is to get Gunther vs. Balor in some sort of contender progression match. Yet there's Danhausen also lurking.Yes. You read that correctly. Danhausen keeps getting involved with Gunther, and that can't be for nothing.Danhausen was just trying out his new device! #WWE #SmackDown pic.twitter.com/KsYmyhi7Tm— USA Network (@USANetwork) October 3, 2026 🚗 Car Crash of the NightAs mentioned, Stratton won her way into this year's women's Money in the Bank ladder match by defeating Candice LeRae and Tatum Paxley. But this match cannot be glossed over, as it would've earned a perfect crown score had Paxley been the victor.Nonetheless the finish sequence was spectacular, and Stratton always makes for a fun addition to a ladder match, so you can't complain too much. The only "problem," per se, is that tonight's match only further highlighted Paxley's in-ring brilliance. She's been great so far in her main roster run, but holy cow — this woman absolutely has it between the ropes, and was the undeniable star of this match. That's without mentioning anything about her character work, which is clearly ever-present. Her style played into her two opponents' perfectly as well, making this match a nonstop, 100-mile-per-hour sprint. And there's nothing more I love than a good high-speed triple-threat.In other words, WWE: Push Paxley. This match was "SmackDown's" equivalent of Bayley vs. Lyra Valkyria vs. Becky Lynch at Evolution last year..@tiffstrattonwwe saw an opportunity and took it! 😱 pic.twitter.com/UvssG388LP— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 👑 Uncrowned Gem of the Night 👑Blake Monroe actually had a match tonight!OK, while that is the Uncrowned Gem of this show, it shouldn't be alone. Tonight's program started with wrestling from the jump, getting into the women's triple-threat, then gave plenty of time to each of the remaining four matches. Overall, it was a great wrestling show, and that's always welcome for obvious reasons. (You know, because this is supposed to be a wrestling show by nature.).@giulia0221g is doing whatever it takes! pic.twitter.com/llRRsTu9we— WWE (@WWE) October 3, 2026 In terms of name value in matches, it's wild how much better Friday nights are than Mondays right now. articles.title: No. 7 Alabama routs No. 16 Mississippi State 56-23 as Keelon Russell stars once again
articles.summary: Mississippi State suffered its first loss of the season on Saturday.
articles.body: Alabama quarterback Keelon Russell just might be the best quarterback in the SEC.Russell outplayed Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor in the No. 7 Crimson Tide's 56-23 win over the No. 16 Bulldogs on Saturday. And it really wasn't close, either.Russell threw for three touchdowns and ran for another, while Taylor committed three turnovers. Mississippi State never led, and the game slipped away from the Bulldogs in the third quarter after Taylor's second interception.After Alabama scored a touchdown on its first possession of the second half to open up a 35-17 lead, MSU had a chance to stay within striking distance. But as running back Kolin Wilson leaked out of the backfield, Taylor overthrew him and the pass landed in the waiting arms of Caleb Woodson.Three plays later, Alabama running back Trae'Shawn Brown had his second rushing TD of the game. And the rout was on.A blip or a dose of reality for Mississippi State?The Bulldogs entered the game 4-0 and had started consecutive seasons with that record for the first time since World War II. In 2025, Mississippi State lost eight of its last nine games to finish 5-8.This season, it's hard to see that happening. But it's also easy to see that the truth of Mississippi State's season lies somewhere in the middle of this undefeated start and the mess that unfolded at home against the Crimson Tide.After becoming one of the breakout stars of September thanks to his ability to make nearly any throw, Taylor had an incredibly forgettable start. He fumbled on the fifth play of the game after he dropped the ball when trying to fake a pass. Three plays into the second drive, he bought himself time and then threw a pick 6 to Dijon Lee after Lee quickly read where Taylor wanted to throw.Add in a Sanfrisco Magee fumble and Mississippi State turned the ball over four times on Saturday. Leading running back Fluff Bothwell also left the game due to injury after just one carry and never returned.Taylor exited the game himself in the second half and slowly walked to the locker room. He finished 19-of-34 passing for 258 yards and three TDs with two interceptions.Fortunately for the Bulldogs, they're off in Week 6 before visiting No. 11 LSU. Then MSU hosts Oklahoma before heading to No. 1 Texas on Halloween.So much for a trap game for the Crimson TideEx-Alabama coach Nick Saban used that exact phrase on ESPN's "College GameDay" before picking his former employer to win. After all, Alabama hosts No. 2 Georgia in Week 6. Looking ahead to one of the biggest games of the year in college football would be understandable.Instead, Alabama showed just why next week's game may be even bigger than we thought.The Tide are not only contenders in the SEC. They look like legitimate national title contenders. That's not something that was said at the beginning of the season.This Alabama team started the season at No. 13 in the AP Top 25. That's more than respectable. But it was the first time Alabama had been ranked lower than eighth to start a season since 2008. That was Saban's second season.Until 2025, when Alabama started the season at No. 8, the Tide had been ranked in the top five in 16 straight AP Top 25s.One of the biggest questions about this iteration of Alabama was at quarterback after Russell beat Austin Mack for the starting job.So far, Russell is acing the test. He finished the game 16-of-22 passing for 285 yards and was able to watch much of the fourth quarter from the bench.Follow all of the action with live updates, highlights and analysis below:

articles.title: 6 arrested for stealing brass bells from temples in Purvanchal
articles.summary: Azamgarh police arrest six for temple brass bell thefts across Purvanchal; 20 bells, Rs 1 lakh cash and two cars seized. Probe continues.
articles.body: Varanasi: Police in Azamgarh have arrested six members of an inter-district gang allegedly involved in stealing brass bells from temples across Purvanchal, seizing 20 stolen bells, Rs 1 lakh cash and two cars used in the crimes.CO (Phulpur) Bhupesh Kumar Pandey said a joint team of Mehnagar and Tarva police raided a spot near Vishunpura turning on the Kharihani-Chiraiyakot road following a tip-off. The gang members were allegedly transferring stolen bells from one car to another when police arrived. They tried to flee but were surrounded and arrested.The accused were identified as Shyam Gupta, Prem Kumar, Pappu Ram, Harsh Gupta, Satish Kumar and Atul Kasera. Pandey said Shyam, who runs a utensils shop, allegedly planned the thefts after suffering business losses. He subsequently formed the gang, whose members stole brass bells from temples in different districts and sold them to Atul Kasera of Mirzapur for around Rs 860 per kg.The gang came under the police scanner after allegedly targeting Pauhari Baba temple in Mehnagar twice within three days. On the night of September 29, the accused stole 11 brass bells and returned on October 1 to steal nine more. A case was registered at Mehnagar police station under Section 305(d) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).During questioning, the accused allegedly admitted to stealing four brass bells from a temple in Saidpur, Ghazipur, on August 7. articles.body: The San Francisco 49ers host the Denver Broncos on Sunday afternoon in Week 4, as Kyle Shanahan & Co. look to maintain their perfect record at Levi's Stadium. They've outscored opponents 71-43 over three games, with quarterback Brock Purdy looking like an MVP to this point in the season, though Denver's defense may just mark his biggest challenge yet. The team did get some good news, as starting wide receiver Mike Evans is officially active after suffering a rib injury last week. The Broncos have seemingly bounced back from a brutal Week 1 loss against the Kansas City Chiefs, now coming off consecutive wins and looking to stack a third in Week 4. Bo Nix has been off to a relatively slow start this season despite two game-winning drives, averaging just over 200 passing yards per game with four touchdowns and three interceptions this year, but he catches a big break facing San Francisco's defense, which remains without Nick Bosa as he works through a calf injury.Where to watch Broncos-49ers in Week 4Broncos-49ers start time: 4:25 p.m. ETLocation: Levi's Stadium | Santa Clara, Ca.TV channel/live stream: CBSFollow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the San Francisco 49ers host the Denver Broncos in Week 4.
